C9-2026-NEURO-001.title: Temporal Interference Stimulation with Tripolar Suppression: A Physical Implementation of Precision-Weighted Active Inference

source.primary: Savvateev et al., Cell Systems (2026), DOI: 10.1016/j.cels.2026.101610

C9-2026-NEURO-001.empirical_claim: Multipair phase-modulated temporal interference electrical stimulation (TIS) achieves focal deep brain activation with significantly reduced off-target effects by introducing a third electrode pair configured to suppress interference outside the target volume. Validated via fMRI, electrophysiology, and calcium imaging in mouse medial prefrontal cortex.

cloud9_cluster_mapping.Cluster_6_SNNs: Tripolar suppression is isomorphic to precision-weighted predictive coding: two carriers generate a hidden-state prediction (beat frequency at depth), third electrode injects anti-correlated field to minimize prediction error (off-target activation). Directly applicable to neuromorphic focal computation in noisy edge arrays.
cloud9_cluster_mapping.Cluster_8_Consciousness: Noninvasive deep modulation of mood-critical circuitry (depression, OCD, addiction) without surgical intervention bridges inner-simulation hypotheses (octopus distributed cognition) with clinically actionable control.
cloud9_cluster_mapping.Cluster_4_EdgeOfChaos: Interference pattern itself is a quasi-periodic signal extraction from non-resonant carriers—mathematically adjacent to QPLS SMBH binary lightcurve analysis.

C9-2026-COSMO-002.title: Planck-Mass Black Hole Remnants and the Inversion of Causal Structure: A Phase Transition in the Cosmological Assembly Index
C9-2026-COSMO-002.layer: Layer 2 (Speculative Theory) — with Layer 3 (Mathematical Fiction) boundary risk
C9-2026-COSMO-002.empirical_claim: Primordial black holes reaching Planck mass (~20 micrograms) do not fully evaporate via Hawking radiation. Instead, evaporation stalls, the event horizon gradually disappears, and the remnant emits 'purifying radiation' with properties resembling a white hole. A 1-billion-ton primordial BH takes ~1 Gyr to reach this stage; smaller BHs reach it almost immediately.

C9-2026-COSMO-003.title: Sgr A* Molecular Wind Cavity: Quiescent-State Geometric Structure as High-Assembly-Index Signature

source.primary: Gorski & Murchikova et al., The Astrophysical Journal Letters (2026)

Stellar winds cannot supply sufficient energy. X-ray emission from Chandra aligns perfectly with the cavity geometry. Wind has been active for ≥20,000 years.

cloud9_cluster_mapping.Cluster_4_EdgeOfChaos: Weak but persistent energy injection maintains system far from equilibrium without catastrophic merger events.
